# MCP reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-mcp-reference.js. Do not edit by hand: run `node scripts/gen-mcp-reference.js`. -->

HypAware serves MCP in two places:

- `hyp mcp serve`, over stdio, for an agent on your machine. It lists the tools core and your active plugins register.
- hypaware-server's `/v1/mcp`, over HTTP, for an agent with a member session or an agent token. What it lists depends on the credential.

Every tool below has a CLI command that does the same thing. Each tool's `tools/list` entry carries its title, description, input schema and hints, as shown here.

## Local tools

Registered by core and the bundled plugins. `hyp mcp serve` lists each one whose plugin is active.

### `graph_neighbors`

**Find related sessions**

Walk the activity graph from a node out to N hops

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Find related sessions |
| Auth class | `read`: listed to any caller the host admits |
| Hints | `readOnlyHint: true` |
| Exposure | `cli+mcp`: a CLI command and an MCP tool on every transport |
| CLI equivalent | `hyp query graph neighbors <node>` |
| Registered by | `@hypaware/context-graph` |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | string | yes |  | `<node>` | Seed node: node_id, natural_key, or label. |
| `depth` | integer, at least 1 | no | `1` | `--depth` | Hops to walk (default 1). |
| `type` | string | no |  | `--type` | Restrict the seed to this node_type. |
| `edge_type` | array of string | no |  | `--edge-type` | Restrict traversal to these edge types. |
| `direction` | string: `out`, `in`, `both` | no | `"both"` | `--direction` | Edge direction to follow (default both). |
| `limit` | integer, at least 1 | no | `100` | `--limit` | Max neighbors to return (default 100). |
| `include-local-only` | boolean | no | `false` | `--include-local-only` | Include local-only graph content even when this context is synced. If this session is itself captured, that content enters the transcript and can be forwarded. |

### `grep_search`

**Search session text**

Grep stored ai_gateway_messages: case-insensitive substring or regex, served from direct scans of the local cache. Covers only these columns: content_text, tool_name, session_id, conversation_id, agent_id, model, cwd, git_branch, git_remote. Every other column, including system prompts (system_text), tool definitions (tools), attributes, and raw frames, is NOT searched, so zero hits is not evidence the text is absent from those columns - read them with query_sql instead

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Search session text |
| Auth class | `read`: listed to any caller the host admits |
| Hints | `readOnlyHint: true` |
| Exposure | `cli+mcp`: a CLI command and an MCP tool on every transport |
| CLI equivalent | `hyp query grep <query>` |
| Registered by | `@hypaware/grep` |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | yes |  | `<query>` | Substring to find (case-insensitive), or a regex pattern with regex: true |
| `regex` | boolean | no |  | `--regex` | Treat query as a regular expression (compiled case-insensitive). Servers restrict regex mode to the operator; local search does not |
| `session_id` | string | no |  | `--session-id` | Only messages of this session |
| `chain_id` | string | no |  | `--chain-id` | Only this chain (matches agent_id or conversation_id) |
| `from` | string | no |  | `--from` | Earliest day, YYYY-MM-DD (page older results by narrowing to) |
| `to` | string | no |  | `--to` | Latest day, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `limit` | integer, at least 1 | no | `50` | `--limit` | Max hits (default 50, max 1000) |
| `include-local-only` | boolean | no |  | `--include-local-only` | Include local-only rows even when this context is synced. If this session is itself captured, their content enters the transcript and can be forwarded. Local search only; a server enforces its own visibility |

### `query_sql`

**Run a SQL query**

Run a SQL query against registered datasets

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Run a SQL query |
| Auth class | `read`: listed to any caller the host admits |
| Hints | `readOnlyHint: true` |
| Exposure | `cli+mcp`: a CLI command and an MCP tool on every transport |
| CLI equivalent | `hyp query sql <sql>` |
| Registered by | core |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sql` | string | yes |  | `<sql>` | A single read-only SELECT over the registered datasets. |
| `include-local-only` | boolean | no | `false` | `--include-local-only` | Include local-only rows even when this context is synced. If this session is itself captured, their content enters the transcript and can be forwarded. |

## Recommendation tools

Served by hypaware-server on `/v1/mcp`. Their names, schemas and CLI equivalents are shared with the client (`src/core/mcp/contracts.js`); `hyp mcp serve` does not list them.

### `get_recommendation`

**Read a recommendation**

Read one recommendation: its summary, status, status history and report. Set `include_evidence` for its evidence locators, basis queries, history reasons and links, and its page (capped at 64 KiB). Reading a cited turn is a separate session_evidence or query_sql call.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Read a recommendation |
| Auth class | `read`: listed to any caller the host admits |
| Hints | `readOnlyHint: true` |
| Exposure | `/v1/mcp` only |
| CLI equivalent | `hyp report get <rec-id>` |
| Registered by | hypaware-server, from the shared contract |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  | The recommendation id (hyprec- and 16 hex characters). |
| `include_evidence` | boolean | no | `false` | Add evidence, basis, history reasons and links, and the page. |

### `list_recommendations`

**List recommendations**

List the recommendations in your org's published reports, summary fields only (no evidence or history). `status` defaults to open. `counts` counts the rows this call read, by state: it is not an org total. Pass the returned `next_before` as `before` for the next page. Read one in full with get_recommendation.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Title | List recommendations |
| Auth class | `read`: listed to any caller the host admits |
| Hints | `readOnlyHint: true` |
| Exposure | `/v1/mcp` only |
| CLI equivalent | `hyp report list --recommendations` |
| Registered by | hypaware-server, from the shared contract |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | array of string: `open`, `in_progress`, `applied`, `dismissed` | no | `["open"]` | States to include (default: open). |
| `kind` | string | no |  | Only recommendations from reports of this kind. |
| `period` | string | no |  | Only recommendations from reports for this period. |
| `limit` | integer, 1 to 100 | no | `20` | Most rows to return (1 to 100). |
| `before` | string | no |  | Page cursor: the `next_before` a previous call returned. |

### `set_recommendation_status`

**Set recommendation status**

Set one recommendation's status. After you have fixed it and checked the fix, mark it applied, with a reason and a link to the change, such as the pull request. Dismissing needs a reason. A mark is added to the recommendation's history; nothing is removed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Set recommendation status |
| Auth class | `write`, scope `report-publish`: listed only to a credential holding the scope; `hyp mcp serve` passes no scopes |
| Hints | `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: false` |
| Exposure | `/v1/mcp` only |
| CLI equivalent | `hyp report mark <id> <state>` |
| Registered by | hypaware-server, from the shared contract |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  | The recommendation id (hyprec- and 16 hex characters). |
| `state` | string: `open`, `in_progress`, `applied`, `dismissed` | yes |  | The new state. |
| `reason` | string | no |  | Why, in a line (at most 2000 characters). Required for dismissed. |
| `links` | array of string | no |  | Links to the change, such as the pull request or commit (absolute http(s) URLs, at most 8). |

## Server-only tools

`session_evidence` and the other tools hypaware-server registers on its own are defined in the server alone, so they have no entry here. Call `tools/list` on `/v1/mcp` for the tools your credential sees, with their titles, schemas and hints.

## Prompts

Each prompt is an agent command as text an agent can run (`prompts/list`, `prompts/get`). A rendering names only the tools the assembly lists.

### `fix_recommendation`

**Fix a recommendation**

Check one recommendation against the current code, make the change in this repository, and record it as applied. Runs with no approval step.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Fix a recommendation |
| Over stdio | always |
| Over `/v1/mcp` | when `get_recommendation` is listed |
| CLI equivalent | `hyp report fix <id>` |

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | The recommendation id (hyprec- and 16 hex characters). |

### `open_recommendations`

**Open recommendations**

List the open recommendations and pick the ones that apply to this repository.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Open recommendations |
| Over stdio | always |
| Over `/v1/mcp` | when `list_recommendations` is listed |
| CLI equivalent | `hyp report list --recommendations --status open` |

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | no | Only recommendations from reports of this kind. |
| `limit` | no | Most recommendations to list (1 to 50). |

**Check team history**

Before starting a task, check whether the team has already done it, and what was decided.

| Title | Check team history |

| Over `/v1/mcp` | always |
